description: Returns recent news on one topic, person, company or event as {query, window_days, summary, developments: [{headline, date, source}]}: a summary of about 50 words and up to 4 dated developments, newest first, usually in 3 to 7 seconds. A short topic or name works better than a full question; days sets the look-back from today (1 to 30, default 7), so a quiet topic needs a larger value. Use web.search for raw links. Read-only; only what the dated results support is returned. Paid per call with x402; if nothing recent is found the call fails and is not charged.

days.description: How many days back to look, 1 to 30. Default 7.
days.title: Days

q.description: The topic, person, company or event to get recent news on, 1 to 500 characters.
q.title: Q

name: web.news

developments.description: Up to 5 dated developments, newest first.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD from the source, or null.

window_days.description: How many days back were searched.
